cases.source: use dsl::*; fn probe() { values.map(|print| print); }
use dsl::*; fn probe(print: i32) -> i32 { print }
use dsl::*; fn probe() { let print = 1; consume(print); }
use dsl::*; fn probe() { for print in values { consume(print); } }
use dsl::*; fn probe() { match value { Some(print) => consume(print), None => () } }
use dsl::*; fn probe(spec: RecordSpec) { print(&spec); let shape: Shape; }
use dsl::*; fn probe() { let print = print(&spec); consume(print); }
use dsl::*; fn probe() { let print = 1; { consume(print); } }
use dsl::*; fn probe(Shape: i32, arg: Shape) { consume(Shape); }
use dsl::*; fn probe() { if let Some(print) = value { consume(print); } }
use dsl::*; fn probe() { while let Some(print) = value { consume(print); } }
use dsl::*; fn probe() { match value { Some(print) if print > 0 => consume(print), _ => () } }
